gen-dafont-visitor-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil has big round lowercase bowls and c and s shapes that look half unwrapped, so it feels modern and open. Visitor's hum stays soft beside it.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-anek-telugu: Nostalgic and digital, Visitor gapes at the e and tucks short ascenders above big bowls. Anek Telugu is the one that reads, with wide, tall bowls and rounds left unlatched like a hook.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-anuphan: Visitor looks traced with one marker tip, its e gaping wide and its ascenders kept short over big bowls. Anuphan follows in a plain sans, with round bowls and curves.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-arimo: Pixel-era toothpaste lettering, squeezed out in one steady line, with gaping e mouths up top. Visitor does the showing off, and Arimo, a sans-serif with a tall mean line and spacious terminal gaps, does the reading.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-armata: Visitor draws its strokes like thick wire, with gaping e mouths and short ascenders above big bowls. Armata, a sans-serif, does the quieter job, with lowercase filling most of the letter height and spacious gaps between characters.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-athiti: Nostalgic and digital, Visitor gapes at the e and pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle. Athiti keeps a gap you can see through in each s, a plain sans with a mean line set high.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Atkinson Hyperlegible, a plain sans, feels approachable, with wide-set terminals on s and clipped ascenders. Visitor adds a wire-like, nostalgic line up top, and the body type keeps the page easy to follow below it.

gen-dafont-visitor-gf-biryani: Gaping mouths on the e mark Visitor, with short ascenders sitting above its big bowls. And Biryani, a sans-serif with a large eye on every e and unclogged counters, steadies the page below.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-blinker: Blinker, a plain sans, holds its line thickness and keeps its apertures open and readable. And Visitor sits above it with a nostalgic, digital hum, gaping e mouths and short ascenders.
